watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier
watchme.consumer: CodeMother, who owns the care of the code, and Akien at the inbox if the exemption clause fires
watchme.enough: clears on the lane's FIRST real refusal — that is the event proving it can bite. Reds if 20 consecutive PROVED crossings journal neither a refusal nor a nonzero ahead_of_upstream, because a lane that never sees unpushed work is reading the wrong thing, not guarding a clean corpus. Also reds unconditionally if _CLEARANCE_EXEMPT_ROSTER or any sibling exemption roster gains a tenant naming this lane.
watchme.nexus: the build_inspector's constraint set — a lane that stopped constraining is corrosion, and constraint_enforcement_holds already reads that set
watchme.trigger: every forward crossing into PROVED — the lane runs on each, and the probe reads the journaled dirty_paths and ahead_of_upstream from the crossing records
